screens.title: Explore
screens.purpose: Discover destinations: a full-bleed featured photo, a floating glass search bar, category chips, a carousel of popular places and a list of deals.
acceptance: A full-width travel photo fills the top of the screen with the featured destination name in large white text over it
A rounded translucent search bar with the placeholder "Où partir ?" floats over the photo near the top
A row of category chips (Tout, Plages, Montagnes…) is visible with the first one highlighted
Photo cards of popular destinations with their names and a rating pill appear below the chips
A bottom tab bar shows Explorer, Voyages, Favoris and Profil

screens.title: Trips
screens.purpose: The user's planned trips as photo cards with dates and a countdown, with totals and a way to plan a new trip.
acceptance: The title "Mes voyages" is shown with a round add button on the right
Three stat tiles show the number of trips, nights and countries
At least three trip cards show a photo, a trip title in white and a dates pill

screens.title: Saved
screens.purpose: Destinations the user saved, as a two-column grid of photo cards.
acceptance: The title "Favoris" is shown with the number of saved destinations
Saved destinations appear as photo cards in two columns, each with a name and a country

screens.title: Profile
screens.purpose: The traveller's profile: avatar, yearly goal progress, stats, appearance switch and preferences.
acceptance: A card shows an avatar with initials, the name "Camille Martin" and a progress bar
A segmented control with Auto, Clair and Sombre is visible
A preferences list includes a toggle and rows for currency and departure airport

screens.title: Place
screens.purpose: One destination: a hero photo, a glass info panel with country, name, rating and key facts, a description, highlights and a floating price bar to plan a trip.
acceptance: A large photo fills the top of the screen with round back and heart buttons over it
A translucent panel overlapping the photo shows the country, the destination name in large text and a star rating
A description paragraph and a numbered list of highlights appear below the panel
A bar at the bottom shows a price in euros and a "Planifier" button

screens.title: New trip
screens.purpose: A form sheet to create a trip: name, destinations, departure month, number of nights and an estimated budget.
acceptance: The title "Nouveau voyage" is shown with a close button
Destination chips with small round photos are shown and at least one is selected
A duration row has minus and plus buttons around a number of nights
An estimated budget in euros and a "Créer le voyage" button are visible
